تستهللن (form X)
# تَسْتَهْلِلْنَ (tastahlilna) /tas.tah.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# تُسْتَهْلَلْنَ (tustahlalna) /tus.tah.lal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
